verdict.rationale: Companies House is a public registry with a REST API, so an official MCP server is a plausible offering and the axis applies. The evidence documents only the REST API, an API-key auth model, and web services, with no MCP server or agent endpoint. The llms.txt probe returned 404, and a REST API is a developer building block, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
